instruction:
This is a Boss Practice fight: you start directly against Dark Rumia's
spellcard "Dark Sign 「Night Fog Miasma」" on Easy, with no stage waves
before it. Her health bar is at the top of the field; deplete it to clear
the phase. This mode gives you a single hit: any bullet or body contact ends
the attempt, so focus (hold Shift) and dodge while you keep firing.

steps.text: Start firing and focus while the spellcard begins.
Keep firing while focusing and gently shifting out of the fog's likely bullet lanes.
Bullets are spreading from the boss's center; moving right slightly to get out of the spoke pattern while keeping fire on.
The spokes are fanning down on both sides of the player, so I'll ease left into the gap while keeping fire and focus on.
Bullet spokes are closing in from both sides of the player, so I'll keep focus and firing while sliding left toward the clearer lane.
Bullet arms are closing on the left side, so I'll focus and drift right into the open gap while Z keeps firing.
Keep focus and firing while sliding right toward the open gap between spokes.
Keep firing and focusing while easing right toward the open gap between spokes.
Start firing with focus held; the player is at the bottom center and needs to fire and dodge.
Bullets are coming from the boss above; shift slightly left with focus to dodge while still firing.
Nudge right with focus to line up under the boss while Z keeps firing and dodging.
Screen is dark with boss above; shift left while Z keeps firing to dodge the spread.
Boss is above center-right and the spread is radial, so I shift right under her while Z keeps firing and focus stays on.
The spread has a gap under the player's column, so I hold position while Z keeps firing with focus.
The bullet streams are converging near the player's column, so a short focused step left looks clearer while Z keeps firing.
The bullet lanes around the player are tight, so I hold still with focus and keep Z firing until a clear gap appears.
Bullet lanes are dense around the player and no clear gap is obvious, so I hold position with focus while Z keeps firing.
No clear gap is visible in the dense lanes, so I hold position with focus while Z keeps firing.
Keep firing at Rumia to deplete her health bar.
Keep firing at Rumia while nudging left, away from the upcoming bullet lines.
Player is at lower-left; bullets are converging from the top-left, so shift right and keep firing.
Bullets are coming down the right-center, so shift left while keeping fire on Rumia.
Rumia is at upper center and the bullet spokes cover the left side, so I move right while keeping fire on her.
Bullet streams sweep down the right side, so I nudge left while keeping fire on Rumia.
Player sits in a relatively open lower-left pocket, so keep firing at Rumia while drifting left away from the spoke lines.
Player is against the left wall with bullets right beside them, so I move right while keeping fire on Rumia.
Bullet lines are thinner on the right of the player near the bottom, so I keep firing at Rumia and drift right briefly.
Bullets are dense on the right and center-bottom, so I drift left into the gap while continuing to fire at Rumia.
Dense bullets are upper-left and the lower area is clearer, so I keep firing at Rumia and drift right away from the cluster.
Bullet lines are denser on the right side now, so I keep firing and drift left into the clearer gap.
Bullets are denser on the left-center now, so I keep firing and drift right into the clearer gap.
Bullets are denser on the right-center and the left lane near the player looks clearer, so I keep firing while drifting left.
Bullet stream sits just above and left of the player, so I keep firing and nudge right into the clearer space.
Bullet streams are converging toward the player's column from above, so I keep firing and nudge left out of the line.
Bullets are concentrated on the left-center column, so I keep firing at Rumia and drift right into the gap.
Bullet streams are on the left side, so I keep firing at Rumia and drift right into the clearer gap.
Bullets cluster to the right-center; keep firing at Rumia and drift left into the clearer lane.
Keep firing at Rumia while nudging left away from the bullet streams converging near the player's column.
Player is low-left with a gap to the left of the bullet column, so I keep firing and focus-nudge left away from the stream.
Player is at the lower-left with bullets sparse nearby, so keep firing and drift right away from the wall-side stream.
Bullets are clustered to the right of the player, so I keep firing and drift left into the open lane.
Bullets are sparse near the player's column, so I keep firing and focus-nudge right into the clear lane.
Bullets are sparse around the player's lower area, so keep firing at Rumia while drifting right out of the spoke lines.
Bullets are concentrated to the right of the player column, so focus-nudge left into the clearer lane while keeping fire on Rumia.
Keep firing at Rumia while focus-nudging left into the sparser lane between the bullet streams.
Bullets are denser on the left side now, so I keep firing at Rumia and drift right into the clearer gap.
Bullets are concentrated on the right of the player, so focus-nudging left keeps dodging while firing at Rumia.
Bullets sit to the left and lower-left of the player, so I keep firing and focus-nudge right into the open gap.
Bullets are denser right of the player column, so keep firing at Rumia and drift left into the gap.
Bullets are clustered left and upper-left; focus-nudging right keeps dodging while continuing to fire at Rumia.
Keep firing at Rumia while focus-nudging left away from the bullet streams on the right.
Bullets are sparse on the left-center lane, so focus-nudge left while keeping fire on Rumia.
Bullet columns sit left of the player, so focus-nudging right keeps firing at Rumia while staying clear.
Bullet columns sit to the left of the player, so drifting right keeps me clear while Z keeps firing at Rumia.
Bullet streams sit to the right and lower-right of the player, so focus-nudging left keeps dodging while Z keeps firing at Rumia.
Bullets are sparse directly below the player column, so I keep firing at Rumia while focus-nudging right out of the left-side streams.
Player sits in a gap with bullet streams to the left and upper-right, so I keep firing and focus-nudge right to stay clear.
Player is in a relatively clear pocket with bullet streams on both sides, so holding still while firing at Rumia is safest.
Bullet streams are closing in on the left and lower-left, so I focus-nudge right while Z keeps firing at Rumia.
The player sits in a fairly open lower-right pocket, so holding still while firing is the safest choice.
Bullets are clustered to the right and center of the player, so a focused nudge left keeps dodging while Z keeps firing at Rumia.
Bullets are sparse on the right side of the player column, so a focused nudge right keeps dodging while Z keeps firing at Rumia.
Yellow bullets are crowding the player's right and upper side, so a focused nudge left keeps dodging while Z keeps firing at Rumia.
Few bullets remain on screen and Rumia appears upper-left around x≈300, so I drift left to line up my upward shot while still firing.
